cues: Here are the ones to recognise.
The cresols, with a methyl group.
The dihydric phenols: catechol, resorcinol and quinol.
Pyrogallol with three O H groups.
And picric acid, two four six trinitrophenol.
Number the ring from the O H carbon, and use o, m and p for two substituents.
text: Here are the ones to recognise. Phenol itself. The cresols, with a methyl group. The dihydric phenols: catechol, resorcinol and quinol. Pyrogallol with three O H groups. And picric acid, two four six trinitrophenol. Number the ring from the O H carbon, and use o, m and p for two substituents.
